title: رسالة إلى الساحل
starting_condition: Complete Mission 003, then speak to Nora Blake near the Marsa Al-Noor lighthouse.

stages.objective: Speak to Nora and accept the original Sapphire Coast delivery request.
Enter the physical Harbor Market shop interior.
Purchase one fruit basket through the live shop transaction and wallet.
Follow the reachable GPS road route and arrive within 8 metres of Sapphire Coast Cafe while driving the starter sedan.
Exit the sedan and deliver the carried fruit basket at the cafe counter.
Receive the $200 reward and continue exploring.

notes: This is a provisional original story proposal and not a final approved campaign chapter.
Vehicle arrival is only accepted while the player is actually seated in a drivable vehicle and the active GPS route is reachable.
The delivery basket is protected from sale until the cafe delivery is completed.
Successful delivery consumes one fruit_basket from player inventory; market stock remains reduced.
Mission stage, wallet, inventory, stock and objective/reward/prerequisite state are persisted in the versioned live-game save.
Dialogue remains text-only. No Arabic voice performance is claimed.
No fail/retry timer or cinematic branch is implemented in this first playable pass.
